_meta.about: Olivia's component catalog — the fixed vocabulary of section/page component TYPES Olivia builds from. Each entry: id, name, category, purpose, needs (the data a section must provide), status (rendered = the view generator already outputs it; reference = a Tailwind archetype in components/references/ ready to be wired), optional reference (a shared archetype id), and optional source. Extend by adding an entry and either reusing an archetype or adding components/references/<id>.html.
_meta.style: Tailwind CDN, brand color via the 'brand' theme color, gradient-free, shadow-light, md radii — must match OliviaViewGenerator output.
